text:
I do not know by what

miracle of reflections

a little thread of sun

stealthily

passes every day

in a slight triangle

through the roof

of my cell.

I wait for it

I spy on it anxiously

I follow it and see it off

with sadness.

But at once I think:

tomorrow it will return

if they do not arrest it.

translation.title: Thread of Sun
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the fragile prison-light image and the final personification of the sun as another possible detainee.
